## Chapter Twenty-One

Cleaning House



The basement was still a damp mess as Lucas and Emma navigated there way deeper into the facility. They had walked at least the length of a football field and there was still plenty of space to go “How big is this freaking place” Emma asked amazed. “I am guessing really big” Lucas answered his mouth hanging open as he looked towards the other end of the room and realizing he could barely make out the far wall even with the basement now well lit. Carefully moving across the slick floor, they navigated around large crates and storage racks. “What the hell is in all of these?” Lucas asked, looking over the wooden crates and the shelves from one end of the building to the other. Emma poked her head into a row and then quickly back out again “Looks like parts and supplies, we are probably going to have to inventory it all” she answered Lucas groaned, that was not a job he was looking forward to.

They moved further and finally Emma pointed towards a sign hanging on the wall that said, “Potable Water Storage System” And they entered the large door into a room with four large round tanks taking up most of the space in the room. The large black tanks looked intact and side from some surface join rust looked fairly new. Lucas circled the large structures, doing a visual inspection of them. “Finish checking the tanks, I need to find the pumps and motors” she said taking off around one of the tanks before Lucas could respond. Shrugging he continued to look over the tanks He finished walking the tanks and went to find Emma going towards the rear of the room he found her bent over a large motor with the cover off. He looked round at the large engine and pipes coming out of the ground and up towards the ceiling where they bent and ran over top of the tanks. Emma continued to root around within the old motor. “Well it’s not going to start yet, we need some supplies before we get this old beast running” she said standing up.

“But once we do, we have enough water to last a while, you see those pipes running up into the ceiling” she asked pointing up. Lucas looked and now he could there were two large pipes running directly up into the ceiling where she had pointed. “Yeah, what’s that for?” he asked, now curious. “That’s feed pipes, its taking water from somewhere , filtering and resupplying these tanks, we will need to inspect them but this system was built to give a lifetimes supply of fresh water” she said, putting the cover back on with a grunt and motioning to Lucas to follow her back upstairs. When they returned the main room was empty and Emma went directly to the large table in the center of the open space. She studied it for a few moments and then smiled. “They spared no expense” she said, wiping the dust off with her hand. “Help me clean this” With a shrug Lucas began doing the same , it took almost thirty minutes but most of the dust was removed and Lucas could see it was a glass table with what looked like some kind of optics underneath it, as if some kind of projection system was pointed towards the center , above the table. “This is old school but based on the same technology we use for our interfaces. With a flip of a switch the table began to hum, and the top glowed a light green. Lucas watched as a distorted picture hovered above the table and smiled “It’s a holo viewer, I mean its freaking huge, but it’s a viewer right” he asked Emma nodded, it needs to be calibrated, but yeah, we have a holo viewer for planning and viewing.” The screen hovering above the table was monochrome green and distorted to where you couldn’t read anything. “I may be able to upgrade it, but we need to go shopping” she said. For a moment Emma rummaged around in the worn black bag that carried her tools.

After a moment she pulled out a small metal ball about half the size of a baseball, she examined it closely and then did something with her finger. The little ball glowed blue and floated into the air.

Lucas whistled “That’s cool, what the hell is it?” he asked smiling as the little ball floated there. “That is blink, I made him, he is like a personal assistant” she said then turned towards the ball “Blink, start a shopping list” she said, the ball hummed and then a little computer simulated voice emitted from the ball “Compliance” it said. Lucas could tell Emma was showing it off Turning back to the ball with a smile she began listing off items, From the oil and some of the smaller electronic items he thought it was a list of things to fix the items they had already seen. He nodded in approval. “That is awesome” he finished. “What’s Awesome?” Victoria called down as she and Sally came out from a hall on the second floor. “He likes Blink” Emma said arching an eyebrow at her fiancé “at least someone does” she finished, and Victoria shot her a withering look. “Yeah until it speeds around your apartment for a month and won’t shut up” she responded, and Emma shot her the finger.

Lucas decided he was going to stay out of that particular lover’s quarrel. “Did you find quarters?” he asked Sally while ignoring the visual barb Victoria was sending their way. He nodded with a smile “Nice accommodations too, we need to find the doc, we have to get organized and get this place running, tonight we rest, but tomorrow we have a lot of work to do” he stated. Lucas nodded “I’ll go find the doc and bring her and Rolle here” he said setting off towards the same direction they had earlier.

He found himself winding down hallway after hallway, this place is massive he thought trying to follow signs towards ‘medical bay’. It looked as if this place could live and staff over a hundred people for an extended amount of time cut off from the surface. He had read about old bunkers used centuries ago in case of nuclear fallout, but had never imagined anything like this, this must have been what they were like. Even though this had been built for an entirely different type of threat. This large facility spelled hope and possibly the ability to rebuild themselves better then before.

If they could stay off the radar and use this as a command center, there was no telling what they would be capable of accomplishing. He thought and then his mind turned towards Job standing there in the photo, smiling as he got his reward for a job well done. He would pay for that Lucas promised. He had been so wrapped up in his own thoughts that he almost missed it when the sign told him he had reached the medical bay.

Turning in he found a large room lined with about twelve patient beds and two offices, along with a room that held some kind of giant scanner. Doc and Rolle were hovering over the large white beast as he entered.

“What the hell is that?” Lucas asked, appreciating the size of the large ring that seem to hover on a track in the air. The ring appeared large enough to accommodate someone standing or a bed being pushed into the middle of it. Doc stood up “I have not seen one of these ever, but I have heard about them, now we have hand held devices that do this sort of thing, but what you are looking at is a full body medical scanner. This beauty takes a realtime constant scan of a patient and then displays it over here” she started, pointing to a platform on one side of the room.

“This thing will allow you to zoom in, in real time on organs or damage and give you options to fix it” Doc pointed up at three robotic arms that terminated in what look like pens. “Okay, so you can write on the patient?” Lucas asked confused. The Doc just chucked and shook her head. “No, those are laser scalpels, they let you perform surgery with a virtual intelligent assistant” Lucas shook his head. “Way above my knowledge base doc, I will take your word its cool” he said with a smile. “Sally needs us back in the main room” and he motioned for them to follow. For a moment the doctor looked like she was going to protest, almost like a kid asked to put down the new toy they opened on Christmas morning, but then acquiesced and followed Lucas and Rolle back towards main room.

Once they entered the room the others were gathered around the table as Sally laid out the facility floor plans as he had seen them. HE turned to see the others enter and motioned them over. “Good, now that everyone is here, we are going to get settled into our quarters, rest tonight, because tomorrow we go to work on this place” he said and getting a nod from the group.

After a long walk down at least three halls and down two levels Lucas found himself in a large single suite complete with mini kitchen and full bathroom. The accommodations weren’t as good as the apartment but a hell of a lot better than prison, he thought.

There were Linens, still shrink-wrapped in the small closet, along with what looked like jumpsuits that staff would wear. He opened a set of sheets and made the bed. Testing the water in the bathroom he found that it had both hot and cold running water, suddenly glad they had turned on the power before finding rooms.

Rooting through the little closet he found another shrink wrapped package of soap, shampoo, shaving cream and a razor along with toothpaste and a toothbrush. He spent thirty long minutes under the hot water scrubbing the mud and dirt from his body and underneath his fingernails. When he got out of the shower, he put on one of the jumpsuits, it fit a bit snug and he would probably have to find something more his size, but it would work for now. The jumpsuit was Blue with the logo of a wolf on the right breast.

Laying down on the bed, he sat back studying the room, its white walls and carpeted floor, he could smell a slight musty smell to the carpet, but otherwise the room as clean, except for the dust. He would need to take care of that first thing he thought as his eyes grew heavy and he felt himself drifting off to sleep.

He awoke with a start as someone was knocking on his door. Looking around it took him a few moments to remember where he was. Lucas swung himself out of bed and walked over to the door to find Rolle on the other side. “Hey man, did you sleep?” his friend asked. Lucas nodded “Like the dead, how about you?” Rolle nodded. “Sally wants us in the main room” he finished pointing down the hall. Realizing he had never actually gotten undressed he went over to the bed and put on the still muddy boots, the mud now dried and leaving a crumbling trail to the door as he walked out to join his friend.

They entered the main room to find the rest of the group digging into rations out of there packs, using the large display table as a dining area.

Lucas walked in and smiled, it had been a long time he thought since he felt like he had a family, every time it seemed to disintegrate or disappear, but now , in this place, at this time he truly felt like he was part of something that he loved and believed in, and the people around him he would do anything for and they would do anything for him. He stood there smiling until Rolle motioned him over and pushed a pack of dried turkey his way. “I had that last time; I can’t do turkey again man” he said and winced looking at the plastic package. Lucas shrugged “It’s fine man, I will take one for the team” and broke open the package to find the dried-out piece of turkey loaf.

The group ate in silence, most like him he thought reflecting on the place they now found themselves in. Once chow had been finished and the packages policed and thrown into a bag that Sally deemed as trash. The group gathered, Sally handing out assignments and Lucas found himself with Emma again leaving the protection of the new Lair and heading out to pick up supplies.

The vehicle was where they left it, A thin sheet of frost covered the top of the van and Lucas used his glove to remove it from the windows while Emma crawled in and started it up. They waited while the heater warmed the large space both staring out the window as their breath fogged the glass and the defroster fought to remove it. “How did you sleep last night?” Emma asked, still watching as the window fogged and then slowly cleared. “I slept better than I have in a long time” he answered “It’s the first time in weeks I have actually felt safe, if that doesn’t sound too weird” he finished shaking his head , it almost sounded like nonsense coming out of his own mouth, but the sentiment was true. Emma smiled at him “I know what you mean, I know we just got there, but that place feels safe, feels almost like it could be a home” she said and then blushed a little “That just sounded..” she started but Lucas cut her off. “No, it doesn’t I get it, I really do”. The Van lifted off and they navigated towards the nearest town.

For the next several weeks Lucas spent a lot of time either in the van or building and cleaning, by the time they had been there going into their third week. Things had begun to settle down.

Lucas woke on the Monday of the groups third week in the complex with a smile. The place was starting to feel like home it was safe and familiar. His apartment had very little In the way of personal belongings though he finally managed to find jumpsuits that fit him properly.

They had spent the better part of that time there getting the essential items working and maintained as well as building a new entrance structure and cleaning the entry hall of the mud.

He showered and dressed quickly, today was the first day they the group would take an honest effort of mapping out the place and finding out what items they had access to , They had spent the last two weeks begging Sally to be able to explore but as he had said, security and essentials first.

He walked into the main room to find Emma sitting at the holo table and Victoria going over one of the work stations that circled the mammoth table. “How is it going?” he asked looking appreciatingly around the room now that it had been properly cleaned during the weekend. It practically sparkled and he savored breathing in the smell of pine vs the old mold smell that had been rampant throughout the building.

“Almost got this table working” came Emma’s voice from underneath the table now that she had practically crawled into the damn thing. Victoria Sat at a workstation concentrating on the new holo viewer, now that all of the systems had been replaced, the area was starting to look like a real command and control. He ignored her as she looked deep in concentration on whatever she was doing and instead turned towards the door as the sound of it opening caught his attention. Rolle came walking in with a smile “You ready to go exploring” he asked excitedly, and Lucas returned the excited grin and shook his head. “I have been dying to see what this place has” he answered.

They both ate a quick breakfast of bagels, the food had become better since they had stocked the community kitchen, but they didn’t feel like cooking, both of them too impatient to get started.

Before Sally arrived, Lucas motioned to Rolle and they took off as fast as they could walk out of the room.

They walked down the main hallway, most of these rooms had been looked at when Sally had been finding the apartments. But most of the way down the hall they find an intersection. Choosing a direction randomly they turned left and walked down the hall. Here the dust on the floor was undisturbed, Lucas pointed it out, letting Rolle know they were the first into this area.

They Slowed as they came to the first door along the hall.

Lucas slowly opened the door entering the large room. The area laid mostly bare except for an odd-looking bed that sat upright. There were leads and wires as well as an odd-looking helmet. Lucas approached the device circling it , behind the bed was a single workstation. Rolle came in behind him “What the hell is this?” he asked curiously, approaching the bed and poking at the helmet and leads. The desk was covered in a thick coating of dust. “I have no idea, get a note of it and we will go to the next room” Lucas said and Rolle pulled a small box out of his pocket and with a spreading of his fingers launched a floating screen, He hit a button on the small holo screen and described the room in as much detail as he could before closing the screen and putting away the device.

They left the room, Lucas marking the door with a slash, using a piece of black chalk they had picked up when out shopping. Moving to the next few rooms they turned out to be your typical offices with nothing of much interest to the two young men.

By the time they had reached halfway down the hall, they finally hit pay dirt. Lucas approached a large metal door that looked more like a safe then your typical door. But the word on it stopped his breath as a smile spread across his features. The word marked in black stencil on the door was ‘ARMORY’.  He looked down at the panel, wiping the dust from it, he leaned down and closely examined it. It required some sort of code and he made an executive decision not to screw with it. “Rolle, record this” he said motioning his hand over the door.

They finished the hall with a few more offices and some supply storage areas, they recorded their findings and headed back to the main room. He knew the others would be out exploring as well. When they got back, they found an irritated Sally looming over the central table. By the look on his face Lucas guessed he wasn’t very happy with them taking off.

“You guys could have waited; I had a whole plan” he said motioning to his own little metal device. Lucas shrugged “Sorry, we got excited, and you going to want to hear what we found” he said excitedly

By the time they finished explaining to Sally what they had discovered, he shared that smile and they waited for the others to return. As they waited Lucas leaned in “So, what do you think is in there?” he asked of Sally and Rolle. Sally shrugged but Lucas could still see the twinkle of excitement in his eyes. “Hopefully, weapons we could use” he simply said. Rolle nodding enthusiastically. “Ones that aren’t gene locked” he finished the thought.

The others filtered in from various areas of the complex, reporting storage rooms, offices, computers, and utility areas, none however had found the goldmine that Lucas and Rolle had. An hour later the entire group found itself standing in front of the mammoth metal door that led to the armory. Victoria and Emma hunkered over the panel like children finding early Christmas presents, they poked and prodded, using every instrument they had on the lock all to no avail , after nearly three hours they had all but given up. “We are not going to break this tonight, or hell ever” Victoria announced defeat slumping her shoulders and hanging her head. “Okay, lets get some sleep we will get a fresh start tomorrow” Sally said clapping his hands to get everyone’s attention. Lucas knew this was the goldmine, they had to get into the armory if they were going to effect real change, they needed to be on the same level as the those they were going up against, they could not try to take on the security services or for that matter any branch of the government as long as they could bring guns and the underground could only bring knives to bear. He could see the frustration on both Rolle and Sally’s faces and knew they shared his thoughts.

Lucas returned to his room, racking his brain to try and figure out how they could possibly get into the most important room they had found in this facility, the one that so far seemed the only place totally locked to there efforts. How ironic he thought to get this far, to find a base that had been nothing but pure legend, to get it up and running and not be able to finish what they started, since the decimation of the underground he had dreamed of getting even , of bringing the fight to those who had taken his father, his friend and those innocent hero’s whose only crime was caring for others.

Lucas had met, known and befriended those the government called lesser, called deviants, called criminals and he could honestly say he had never met a more caring and honorable group then those the government cast out and oppressed.

There was a knock at his door, and he looked up to see Emma and Victoria, the defeat of earlier still present in their slumped posture and down turned eyes.

“Hey” Emma said as Lucas motioned them into the apartment. “Come sit, how are you guys doing” he asked gently as they walked in and plopped on the couch that had come with the place. “I don’t know if we are ever going to get into that damn room Lucas, I mean the security on it even being as old as it is, is beyond our ability to break it, if we try too many wrong codes or bad attempts, the system will blow the bolts and lock the door permanently” Emma answered wincing at the thought of that outcome.

Lucas looked at the floor in thought, he knew they had gone over the entire door with every sensor and system they owned. He knew they would have a detailed scan of the door and the panel, so he trusted their assessment, despite its dire prediction. “What about drilling through the door?” He asked hopefully looking between the two of them, He could see the answer in their eyes before they uttered a word. Emma answered first, her spiked blue hair shimmering in the bright artificial light of the apartment as she shook her head. “No, the door is four feet thick and made of a composite titanium, also the inside of the door is covered with sensors, if we tripped one, then the bolts would blow”. Lucas nodded; it would have been a long shot, but he had to ask. “What about the wall, what happens if we bypass the door” he asked avoiding the hope that welled up at the thought.

Victoria took this one, again with a shake of her long blonde hair, which currently hung in her face shading the ocean blue eyes that had captured him the first time he saw her. “No, the walls are all at least eight feet thick and permeated with the same sensors, same with the floor and ceiling, our only hope is to get that door to open voluntarily” she finished. Answering the last of his questions as they died a still birth in his throat.

Lucas got up and began to pace, he clenched his fist in frustration at being so close yet so far from the prize they so desperately needed. “There has to be some way into that vault, we can’t have come all this way to fail now” he stated mustering as much determination into his tone to combat the growing despair. Could this be there end he thought, could this be where the underground dies its quiet death, dealt the mortal blow by Job’s Machiavellian machinations. No, he answered himself, that would not be the case, they would overcome this obstacle.

They both watched Lucas pace the small apartment, practically running a landing pad into the beige carpet. “Lucas, tell me about this machine you found?” Emma suddenly asked, her eyes going distant and her look thoughtful. Lucas stopped to level a quizzical gaze on the young woman, and he noticed so did Victoria. “Why?” Her fiancé simply asked, and Emma shrugged. “I don’t know, there is something about that, something that almost seemed familiar” she said, looking to Lucas to answer her.

With a shrug he described the single machine and terminal in the large room and the leads as well as the helmet and how odd he thought of the bed since it stood straight up, making it impossible to sleep in. She continued to look off into the distance for a moment. “Something about that seems familiar, can you take us there?” she finished glancing between the questioning look of Victoria and the confused look on his own face. Shrugging he simply said “sure” he didn’t think he would be able to sleep anyway and motioned them to follow him as he headed for the door of the apartment.

He led them through the halls and came to the door of the research room. He opened it and let the girls in first. Emma went straight to the machine and began to study it, looking over the leads and pulling a few of the panels, her concentration so focused it was as if he and Victoria weren’t even In the room.

She wandered over to the terminal and tried to turn it on to no avail and with a whispered curse, she got down under the table and began to look over the wiring and other items that Lucas couldn’t see. She got up , went back to the machine and practically crawled into the panel under it as well. After a few moments he got up and dusted her jumpsuit off, Lucas noticed it was similar to the one he wore as well, she must have raided the supply of them in one of the storage rooms. “I need to run some new wiring , it looks like there are some corroded connections, but I want to see if I can get this powered up, why don’t you guys go to bed and come back in the morning, I don’t want to say anything until I have had a look at the machines logs” she simply said. Lucas felt she thought she was onto something but wasn’t ready to share. So, he motioned to Victoria to join him and they went back to the section where there apartments were.

The two parted ways when Lucas reached his door. He turned to his friend “Is Emma Okay?” he asked and then quickly specified “She has seemed distant today” Victoria nodded. “She isn’t taking the isolation well and she hasn’t recovered from the death of our friends” She finished getting a nod from Lucas, he understood that and chided himself for not seeing it sooner. With a nod they parted ways and he entered his apartment. Going to the bed and laying down,

He layed there for an hour before the need for sleep overtook his body and he drifted off hearing the screams of those who had lost their life at babel and hearing the final words of his once friend and now traitor “its just business” echoing over and over in his mind.
